```python
import heapq

def second_largest(xs):
    largest = 0
    second_largest = 0
    for value in xs:
        # Move element into max heap faster to walk in reverse order
        max_stack = heapq.nlargest(2, xs)
        if max_stack[0] > value:
            # Item is lower than existing value, so get rid of it
            heapq.heappop(max_stack)
            heapq.heappush(max_stack, value)
        if value > largest:
            second_largest = largest
            largest = value
        elif value > second_largest and value != largest:
            second_largest = value

    if second_largest == 0:
        return None
    else:
        return second_largest
```

def second_largest(xs):
    if len(xs) < 2:
        return None

    heap = [-x for x in unique_values]
    heapq.heapify(heap)

    second_heap = [-x for x in unique_values if x != largest]
    heapq.heapify(second_heap)

    # The second largest value is now at the root of the second heap
    return -heapq.heappop(second_heap)
